text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and what causes it. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to examine their code closely. A systematic approach is also helpful. Instead of guessing, you should test one part at a time and check the results. Logging is another useful method. By adding log messages, you can see what happens while the program runs. With patience and good strategies, you can solve most bugs successfully.
